words.English Meaning: to go to work / on duty
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我每天早上八点半准时上班。(Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang bā diǎn bàn zhǔnshí shàngbān.) — I go to work punctually at 8:30 every morning.

words.English Meaning: to get off work / off duty
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 今天下班后你有空一起吃饭吗？(Jīntiān xiàbān hòu nǐ yǒu kòng yìqǐ chīfàn ma?) — Do you have time to eat together after work today?
为了赶进度，我们今晚需要加班。(Wèile gǎn jìndù, wǒmen jīnwǎn xūyào jiābān.) — To catch up on progress, we need to work overtime tonight.

words.English Meaning: to hold a meeting / to attend a meeting
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 下午两点全体员工在大会议室开会。(Xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn quántǐ yuángōng zài dà huìyìshì kāihuì.) — All staff will meet in the main conference room at 2 PM.
张经理正在和新客户谈合作。(Zhāng jīnglǐ zhèngzài hé xīn kèhù tán hézuò.) — Manager Zhang is discussing cooperation with a new client.
我和同事们相处得非常融洽。(Wǒ hé tóngshìmen xiāngchǔ de fēicháng róngqià.) — I get along very well with my colleagues.
老板同意了我们提出的新方案。(Lǎobǎn tóngyì le wǒmen tíchū de xīn fāng'àn.) — The boss approved our new proposal.
李总在三楼的办公室等你。(Lǐ zǒng zài sān lóu de bàngōngshì děng nǐ.) — Director Li is waiting for you in the office on the 3rd floor.
我已经把项目合同发邮件给你了。(Wǒ yǐjīng bǎ xiàngmù hétong fā yóujiàn gěi nǐ le.) — I have already emailed the project contract to you.
请帮我打印三份开会材料。(Qǐng bāng wǒ dǎyìn sān fèn kāihuì cáiliào.) — Please help me print three copies of the meeting materials.
大家都在认真准备明天的演讲。(Dàjiā dōu zài rènzhēn zhǔnbèi míngtiān de yǎnjiǎng.) — Everyone is diligently preparing for tomorrow's presentation.
这项任务必须在周五前完成。(Zhè xiàng rènwu bìxū zài zhōuwǔ qián wánchéng.) — This task must be completed before Friday.
他负责市场部的产品推广。(Tā fùzé shìchǎngbù de chǎnpǐn tuīguǎng.) — He is in charge of product promotion in marketing.
我们团队正在做一个新软件项目。(Wǒmen tuánduì zhèngzài zuò yí gè xīn ruǎnjiàn xiàngmù.) — Our team is working on a new software project.
我已经写好了上个月的财务报告。(Wǒ yǐjīng xiě hǎo le shàng gè yuè de cáiwù bàogào.) — I have finished writing last month's financial report.

words.English Meaning: to ask for leave / time off
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我需要请假，因为我生病了。(Wǒ xūyào qǐngjià, yīnwèi wǒ shēngbìng le.) — I need to ask for leave because I'm sick.
因为堵车，今天早上我迟到了。(Yīnwèi dǔchē, jīntiān zǎoshang wǒ chídào le.) — Because of traffic, I arrived late this morning.
公司每个月十号发工资。(Gōngsī měi gè yuè shí hào fā gōngzī.) — The company pays salaries on the 10th of every month.
他明天下午有一场重要面试。(Tā míngtiān xiàwǔ yǒu yì chǎng zhòngyào miànshì.) — He has an important interview tomorrow afternoon.
大家对这个方案还有什么问题吗？(Dàjiā duì zhè ge fāng'àn hái yǒu shénme wèntí ma?) — Does anyone have any questions about this plan?

words.English Meaning: to resolve / to settle / to solve
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 技术团队很快解决了系统故障。(Jìshù tuánduì hěn kuài jiějué le xìtǒng gùzhàng.) — The tech team resolved the system fault very quickly.
非常高兴能与贵公司合作！(Fēicháng gāoxìng néng yǔ guì gōngsī hézuò!) — Very glad to cooperate with your esteemed company!
我们下周再仔细讨论这个细节。(Wǒmen xià zhōu zài zǐxì tǎolùn zhè ge xìjié.) — Let's discuss this detail carefully next week.
我和大家的意见一致，完全同意。(Wǒ hé dàjiā de yìjiàn yízhì, wánquán tóngyì.) — My opinion matches everyone's, I completely agree.
他在国际贸易方面有丰富经验。(Tā zài guójì màoyì fāngmiàn yǒu fēngfù jīngyàn.) — He has rich experience in international trade.
